name: Geographx 10 m terrain imagery service
description: DOC-hosted Geographx-attributed 10 m terrain-imagery map cache in NZTM2000, distinct from the Geographx 8 m DEM.
story: The Department of Conservation has published a cached map service named Terrain/Geographx10m. Its ArcGIS REST service describes a 10 m-resolution terrain-imagery layer, credits Geographx and uses the New Zealand Transverse Mercator 2000 coordinate system (NZTM2000, EPSG:2193).

The service demonstrates a second Geographx-derived national terrain product used in GIS delivery. The service record does not establish the original production date or show that this 10 m map cache is the same product as the Geographx 8 m elevation raster. Neither a TV3 weather-graphics use nor an unrestricted image-republication licence has been verified.
